items.proposal: Boss, row W3-2, strongest_rejected_alternative, severity high, with its escalation: 'Rejected for the seam: the question chain of 9:1-9:2 continues in 9:4-9:6 with the same rights vocabulary' misstates the bytes. The boss reports that 9:2 ends in a statement in RP and SBL and that no rights word stands at 9:1 or 9:2. The orchestrator takes no reading of the seam. Restate the ground on what the witnesses hold, by exact span, and rule whether the rejection of the 9:2/9:3 seam stands on the restated ground. If it does not stand, say so and hold the item; no span moves in this round.

Boss, row W3-2, observed_substrate_signals[1], severity medium: 'rights vocabulary at 8:9, 9:4, 9:5, 9:6 and 9:12 (MEASURED, script measure_w3: 12 verses book-wide)' takes in the verb form at 7:28 and names a script R5-S5-11 records as not preserved. The boss's figure of 11 is INFERRED. Measure the count yourself, then order the span that states the figure, its tier and the rule that counted it.

Boss, row W3-1, strongest_rejected_alternative, severity medium: the sentence saying the Peri at 8:4 resumes with 'a bare Περὶ and no connective' quotes a run that holds οὖν, and the same field's next sentence calls it resumptive οὖν. The boss reports that the rejection of the 8:3/8:4 seam rests on the οὖν and is untouched. Order the span that removes the contradiction.

Boss, row W2-6, device_notes and boundary_evidence_refs[8], severity medium: the quoted run labelled a future ends on ἤγειρεν; the verse goes on to ἐξεγερεῖ. Decide whether the quotation is carried on to the form or the label goes, and order the spans. Under the quotation rule of this round a quotation may be replaced only by a contiguous run of the same witness line.

Boss, W6-1 to W6-14, device_notes, severity low: filler in the 'Witness lines' sentence in all 14 rows. The orchestrator proposes one exact span per row, removing the filler and no other word, if the sentence carries nothing a reader needs. Otherwise leave it and say why. Read the sentences by script.

Boss, W4-1, W4-2, W4-4 strongest_rejected_alternative and W6-10, W6-11, W6-12 device_notes, severity low: process wording in row fields ('for end review', 'a question for end review', wording naming Fable). The question the words carry stays routed. The orchestrator proposes exact spans that remove the process wording and keep the claim, or leaving it with a reason. Do not reopen the routed question.

Boss, severity low, one sentence each: W1-011 boundary_rationale ('the opening verse of the next paragraph', a mark-derived word beside the seam, location only); W2-15 boundary_rationale ('7:40 ends on Paul's judgment' though the verse goes on, and W3-1 cites the rest); W4-2 strongest_rejected_alternative ('the questions of 11:13-11:15' fits SBL punctuation, while RP has a statement at 11:15 and RP is the row's quotation base); W5-2 device_notes (12:6 is named among signs inside a list whose range the row gives as 12:8-12:10). Rule each one: span, leave with a reason, or route.

Boss, W4-3 boundary_rationale and observed_substrate_signals[8]: 'MEASURED by the lane script gen_w4' names a script neither pinned nor preserved, and the boss's own measure agrees with the count of 5. The W3 rows' measure_w3 label is already under R5-S5-11. Decide whether this takes the treatment R5-S5-11 gave measure_w3 or an exact span.

Boss escalation: B3, B4, B7, B8 are NOT_TESTABLE because the orchestrator's brief did not name their files. The orchestrator proposes a delta boss execution e2, read whole on every row FIXUP-5 changes, with B3, B4, B7, B8 re-run on named files: 1Cor/fixup/draft_rows_fixup2_applied.jsonl, 1Cor/review/tool_fixes/fixtures_tf4.result.json, fixtures_tf5.result.json and mutants_tf5.result.json. Rule whether that is enough and whether e1 and e2 together may stand as the boss record, and name the run that decides each clause.

Set the gate. The orchestrator proposes: FIXUP-5 is applied by campaign/_apply_exact_orders.py with no author; suite, tiling, ngram7 --gate 10 and the sweep run on the applied rows; the delta boss of R7-NOT-TESTABLE runs; no S8 unless you find one owed; the final rows are struck from the FIXUP-5 applied rows once the boss record is all MET and no row stands at RETURN. Name, for any clause you keep or write, the run that decides it.
